name: The Westin La Quinta Golf Resort & Spa
positioning: The Westin La Quinta Golf Resort & Spa, Benahavís, Marbella: a golf and spa resort in Marbella's Valley of Golf, between the Sierra Blanca mountains and the Mediterranean, with a 27-hole course and a Moorish-style spa
best_for: Golfers who want a 27-hole course at the door on the Costa del Sol
Couples who want terrace rooms with mountain views and a full spa circuit

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by the Sierra Blanca mountains and the Mediterranean, 10 minutes by car from Marbella.
La Quinta Golf & Country Club has three 9-hole championship courses designed by Manuel Piñero.
Puerto Banús marina is about 10 minutes away.
Rooms have private terraces or balconies.
The Presidential Suite has a private sauna.
The Heavenly Spa is dedicated to the history of Andalusia.
The spa has a Mediterranean sauna, an aromatic steam room, sensorial showers and an ice fountain.
The Aljama Bar is the hotel's cocktail bar, with Arabic decor.
An olive oil experience connects guests with the land and traditions of Andalusia.
Malaga Airport and a high-speed train station are 45 minutes away.

highlights.text: The resort is in Marbella's Valley of Golf and has a 27-hole golf course.
The Heavenly Spa is designed in Moorish style and has a hydrotherapy pool.
The Presidential Suite has a vast terrace with an outdoor whirlpool tub and sunbeds.
Panoramic Rooms look out over the pool, gardens and mountains from private terraces.
The Clubhouse Restaurant & Bar has a large year-round terrace with panoramic golf course views.

considerations.text: The resort is in the hills near Marbella rather than on the beach; WhataHotel notes guests need a car or taxi to reach Marbella town and the beaches.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for dining, spa and golf.
